name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: The angler who landed the Perch's weight is immediately below Boone.
The angler who landed the Bluegill's weight is higher than both Cody and the angler who landed the Bass.
Mabel's weight is immediately below the angler who landed the Perch.
